decisions.reason: The distributed ALCMS control unit sits at the core of the firm's airfield lighting expertise, and its own R&D lets it interpret field results and refine the product.
The air situation display builds on the firm's tower and surveillance offer and gained its own page, so the firm has the related knowledge to assimilate feedback and improve it.
The airport systems training program draws directly on the firm's operational and system know-how, and it supports its installed base.
The airfield ground lighting course rests on the firm's strongest domain, although it was only mentioned on the site, so it may be folded into broader training offers.
The collaboration software tool fits the firm's strategic direction toward integrated, data-driven collaborative decision-making, which its R&D and integration capabilities support.
The MLAT surveillance system extends the firm's surveillance and guidance knowledge, its in-house R&D enables iterative improvement, and the launch was prominently announced.
